feeds.title: Transgender Trend
feeds.description: Welcome to Transgender Trend. We are a group of parents who question the medical transition of children, the teaching of 'gender identity' ideology in schools and policies and legislation based on the subjective idea of 'gender' in place of the biological reality of sex.

feeds.title: YATGB (Yet Another T-Girl Blog)
feeds.description: Authored by Lynn Jones, a married trans woman with two children, Yet Another T-Girl Blog was created for Lynn to connect with people like her, and discuss life as a trans person. Covering everything from trans rights, fashion tips, family life, and the happenings and talks at the trans support group, Nottingham Chameleons, Yet Another T-Girl Blog provides an open place for discussion and awareness.

feeds.title: Growing Up Transgender
feeds.description: We are parents in a family that includes a young trans child. We are blogging anonymously to protect their (and our identities). We welcome constructive comments but please don't be offended if we don't respond.

feeds.title: Andie's Place Blog
feeds.description: I began this blog in January 2012. At the time I knew that I was a bit more than transgender. This blog now relates the journey, week by week, as I wrestled with reality, from deciding that I had no choice, to coming out completely and transitioning to a female life, going through the process of assessment and diagnosis and to gender confirmation surgery.
